reviews.name: Engineered
reviews.premise: Archivo carries headings and prose across a real weight range; Martian Mono holds every number. Built like equipment.
reviews.headline: 38.5% win rate. −0.36% expectancy.
reviews.body: Marks are delayed and labelled delayed. Trades that resolved neither way are shown, not dropped. The bot reports no win rate until real trades close, because a number before then would be invented.
